item.title: Fri Nov 13 · Two-host show · Nvidia CEO exits; Modine bid lifts data-center power
item.description: Format: Two-host show. Data today. 8:30 AM October PPI (producer prices). Tuesday's hot CPI put a December hike in play, so a hot PPI would press growth and small caps again. The data card at about 8:45 covers the reaction. Where we are. Scenario A (money still leaving) holds on official numbers for Nov 12: 69.5 percent of dollar volume in falling stocks, net minus 273 billion dollars, 52 stocks up 4 percent+ versus 288 down, T2108 53.2.
